title: Preview
description: A live frame, such as a Storybook story, with its caption and links. Drawn by the Preview composite on a component's page.

robot.description: The robot that sleeps while the frame is not live: its day and night pictures. The theme picks one.

day.description: The day picture's path, from the site's base URL.

night.description: The night picture's path, from the site's base URL.

title.description: What the frame shows, such as Button examples in Storybook. It names the frame for a screen reader.

wait.description: What to start to see the frame live, shown until it loads. A command follows the colon.

light.description: The frame's address in light mode, as a site path.

dark.description: The frame's address in dark mode. With it, the frame shows Light and Dark tabs.

frames.description: The frame's address in each mode.

caption.description: A short line under the frame.

href.description: The link, as a site path.
